```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
get_most_recent_obs <-
  function(df, id_col, date_col = "eingangsdatum") {
    df %>% group_by(across(all_of(id_col))) %>% slice_max(order_by = across(all_of(date_col)),
                                                          n = 1,
                                                          with_ties = FALSE)
  }
```

```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}}
features <- c(demo, csf_vars, mri_vars)

# Numeric conversion
to_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Only convert existing columns
existing_features <- features[features %in% names(dat)]
dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), to_numeric))

# Helper: 1-vs-all stats
one_vs_all <- function(df, var, group_col) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(group_col), all_of(var)) %>% drop_na()
  if(nrow(d) < 6) return(tibble(group=character(), var=var, p=NA_real_, q=NA_real_))
  levs <- d %>% pull(all_of(group_col)) %>% as.factor() %>% levels()
  res <- lapply(levs, function(g) {
    x <- d %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == g) %>% pull(all_of(var))
    y <- d %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] != g) %>% pull(all_of(var))
    if(length(x) < 3 || length(y) < 5) return(tibble(group=g, var=var, p=NA_real_))
    pval <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(group=g, var=var, p=pval)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  res %>% mutate(q = p.adjust(p, method="BH"))
}

stats_by <- function(df, vars, group_col) {
  bind_rows(lapply(vars, function(v) one_vs_all(df, v, group_col))) %>%
    mutate(grouping = group_col)
}

# Aggregation to matrices
agg_matrix <- function(df, vars, group_col, fun = median) {
  df %>%
    select(all_of(group_col), all_of(vars)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(vars), ~fun(.x, na.rm=TRUE)), .groups="drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames(group_col) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.matrix()
}

# Scale rows
scale_rows <- function(m) {
  m2 <- t(scale(t(m)))
  m2[is.na(m2)] <- 0
  m2
}

nice_row_names <- function(vars) {
  nms <- pretty_names[vars]
  nms <- ifelse(is.na(nms), vars, nms)
  unname(nms)
}

# Build heatmap function with black boxes around variable blocks
build_heatmap <- function(group_col, file_pdf) {
  vars_present <- existing_features
  st <- stats_by(dat, vars_present, group_col)
  mat <- agg_matrix(dat, vars_present, group_col, median)
  zmat <- scale_rows(mat)

  # Asterisk matrix
  q_tab <- st %>%
    select(group, var, q) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = q, values_fill = NA) %>%
    column_to_rownames("var")

  q_tab <- q_tab[rownames(zmat), colnames(zmat), drop=FALSE]

  stars_from_q <- function(q) {
    if(is.na(q)) return("")
    if(q < 0.001) return("***")
    if(q < 0.01)  return("**")
    if(q < 0.05)  return("*")
    ""
  }

  star_mat <- matrix("", nrow=nrow(zmat), ncol=ncol(zmat), dimnames = dimnames(zmat))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(zmat))) {
    for(j in seq_len(ncol(zmat))) {
      star_mat[i,j] <- stars_from_q(q_tab[i,j])
    }
  }

  # Row order and blocks
  row_order <- rownames(zmat)
  row_block <- case_when(
    row_order %in% demo ~ "Demo",
    row_order %in% csf_vars ~ "CSF",
    row_order %in% mri_vars ~ "MRI",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )

  # Row annotation
  ha_rows <- rowAnnotation(
    Block = factor(row_block, levels = c("Demo","CSF","MRI","Other")),
    col = list(Block = c(Demo="grey80", CSF="grey40", MRI="grey10", Other="#d9d9d9")),
    width = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

  # Colors
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#004c4c","#f7f7f7","#de7a00"))

  # Heatmap with black boxes around each row split block
  ht <- Heatmap(
    zmat,
    name = "Z-score",
    col = col_fun,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_order = row_order,
    column_title = paste(ifelse(group_col == "diagnosis_label", "Diagnosis Cohort", "Diagnosis Grouped")),
    row_labels = nice_row_names(rownames(zmat)),
    row_split = factor(row_block, levels = c("Demo","CSF","MRI","Other")),
    row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),  
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
    border = TRUE,  
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
      lab <- star_mat[i, j]
      if(nchar(lab) > 0) {
        grid::grid.text(lab, x = x, y = y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black", fontface = "bold"))
      }
    }
  )

  
  pdf(file_pdf, width = ifelse(group_col == "diagnosis_label",5,3.5), height = 10)
  draw(ha_rows + ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  dev.off()

  cat("Saved:", file_pdf, "\n")
}


# Generate both heatmaps
build_heatmap("diagnosis_label", "Figures/heatmap_diagnosis_label_stars.pdf")
build_heatmap("dg_alsftd", "Figures/heatmap_dg_alsftd_stars.pdf")
```

# 6 ALS Models

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
df$dg_alsftd_numeric <- as.numeric(as.factor(df$dg_alsftd))
df$als_ftd_binary <- ifelse(df$diagnosis_label == "ALS", 1, 0)

feature_cols_mri <- df %>% 
  select_if(is.numeric) %>% 
  select(
    -als_ftd_binary, -dg_alsftd_numeric, -rn, -time_to_event, -manifestation_year, # demographics
    -alsfrs_score, -updrs_3_score, -edss_score, # clinical scores
    -alsfrs_score, -updrs_3_score, # more scores
    -medication_cognitive, -medication_parkinsonian, -medication_antidepressants, -medication_antipsychotics
   ) %>% 
  names()

feature_cols <- setdiff(feature_cols_mri, 
                        c("mta_right", "mta_left", "gca", "fazekas_grade", "amyloid_angiopathy"))

# XGBoost: Demo + Clin + CSF
set.seed(123)
X <- as.matrix(df[, ..feature_cols])
y <- df$als_ftd_binary
importance_df <- xgboost(
    data = X,
    label = y,
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    nrounds = 100,
    max_depth = 10,
    eta = 0.1,
    subsample = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    verbose = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) %>%
  xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X), model = .) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(Feature = reorder(Feature, Gain))

# XGBoost: Demo + Clin + CSF + MRI
X <- as.matrix(df[, ..feature_cols_mri])
y <- df$als_ftd_binary
importance_df_mri <- xgboost(
    data = X,
    label = y,
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    nrounds = 100,
    max_depth = 10,
    eta = 0.1,
    subsample = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    verbose = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) %>%
  xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X), model = .) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(Feature = reorder(Feature, Gain))

# plotting
p1 <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Gain, y = Feature)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#853636",color = "grey4", alpha = 0.7, width =0.6) +
  labs(title = "XGB 1: Demo + Clin + CSF",x = "Importance (Gain)", y = "Features") +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = pretty_names) +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(importance_df_mri, aes(x = Gain, y = Feature)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#eb6060",color = "grey4", alpha = 0.7, width =0.6) +
  labs(title = "XGB 2: + MRI",x = "Importance (Gain)", y = "Features") +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = pretty_names) +
  theme_bw()

cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = list(p1,p2), cols = 2, align = "h")
ggsave("Figures/als_importance.pdf", width = 7, height = 3)
```

## 6.2 Train XGBoost 
```{r fig.height=3 fig.width= 3}
set.seed(123)

# Create train-test split with stratification
train_indices <- createDataPartition(y = df$als_ftd_binary, 
                                     p = 0.75, 
                                     list = FALSE, 
                                     times = 1)

# Split the data
X_train <- X[train_indices, , drop = FALSE]
X_test <- X[-train_indices, , drop = FALSE]
y_train <- y[train_indices]
y_test <- y[-train_indices]


# Train simple model with only pTau_tTau_ratio
X_simple_train <- X_train[, "pTau_tTau_ratio", drop = FALSE]
X_simple_test <- X_test[, "pTau_tTau_ratio", drop = FALSE]
simple_model <- xgboost(
  data = X_simple_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 2,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.9,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Use the optimal features for XGBoost: Demo + Clin + CSF model
xgb1_features <- importance_df$Feature
X_xgb1_train <- X_train[, xgb1_features, drop = FALSE]
X_xgb1_test <- X_test[, xgb1_features, drop = FALSE]
xgb1_model <- xgboost(
  data = X_xgb1_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 10,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.9,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Use the optimal features for XGBoost: Demo + Clin + CSF + MRI model
xgb2_features <- importance_df_mri$Feature
X_xgb2_train <- X_train[, xgb2_features, drop = FALSE]
X_xgb2_test <- X_test[, xgb2_features, drop = FALSE]
xgb2_model <- xgboost(
  data = X_xgb2_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 15,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.9,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Make predictions on TEST data only
simple_predictions <- predict(simple_model, X_simple_test)
```

## 6.3 Bootstrapping for XGBoost

```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Function to perform bootstrap sampling and calculate AUC
bootstrap_auc <- function(model, X_data, y_true, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  auc_values <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  n_samples <- length(y_true)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    bootstrap_indices <- sample(1:n_samples, n_samples, replace = TRUE, prob = 0.5 + 0.5 * (y_true == 1))
    y_boot <- y_true[bootstrap_indices]
    if (is.matrix(X_data)) {
      X_boot <- X_data[bootstrap_indices, , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      X_boot <- X_data[bootstrap_indices]
    }
    pred_boot <- predict(model, X_boot)
    auc_values[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc(y_boot, pred_boot, quiet = TRUE)))
  }
  return(auc_values)
}

# Perform bootstrap AUC calculation for each model
simple_auc_bootstrap <- bootstrap_auc(simple_model, X_simple_test, y_test, 500)
xgb1_auc_bootstrap <- bootstrap_auc(xgb1_model, X_xgb1_test, y_test, 500)
xgb2_auc_bootstrap <- bootstrap_auc(xgb2_model, X_xgb2_test, y_test, 500)

# Create data frame for plotting
auc_data <- data.frame(
  AUC = c(simple_auc_bootstrap, xgb1_auc_bootstrap, xgb2_auc_bootstrap),
  Model = factor(
    rep(c("pTau:tTau", "XGB1", "XGB2"), each = 500),
    levels = c("pTau:tTau", "XGB1", "XGB2")  # Explicit factor levels
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE  # Ensure factor structure
)

my_comparisons <- list(
  c("pTau:tTau", "XGB1"),
  c("XGB1", "XGB2"), 
  c("pTau:tTau", "XGB2")
)

p_bootstrap <- ggplot(auc_data, aes(y = AUC, x = Model, fill = Model)) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0) +
  geom_jitter(size = 1, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21) + 
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons, 
    show.legend = TRUE, 
    method = "t.test",
    label = "p.format"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey30", "#853636", "#eb6060")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Bootstrap AUC Values", fill = "Model") +
  ggtitle("ALS Bootstrap AUC Comparison") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1.1))  # Add space for p-value annotations

# Save the plot
print(p_bootstrap)
ggsave("Figures/als_bootstrap_auc_comparison_fixed.pdf", width = 3.5, height = 5)


# Print summary statistics
summary_stats <- auc_data %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(AUC),
    Median = median(AUC),
    SD = sd(AUC),
    CI_lower = quantile(AUC, 0.025),
    CI_upper = quantile(AUC, 0.975),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
print(summary_stats, digits = 4)
```

```{r fig.height=3 fig.width= 3}
y_train <- y[train_indices]
y_test <- y[-train_indices]

# Train simple model with only pTau_tTau_ratio on training data
X_simple_trat_train <- X_train [, "pTau_tTau_ratio", drop = FALSE]
X_simple_trat_test <- X_test[, "pTau_tTau_ratio", drop = FALSE]
simple_model_trat <- xgboost(
  data = X_simple_trat_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 2,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Train simple model with only csf_igg_iga_ratio on training data
X_simple_irat_train <- X_train [, "csf_rat_form", drop = FALSE]
X_simple_irat_test <- X_test[, "csf_rat_form", drop = FALSE]
simple_model_irat <- xgboost(
  data = X_simple_irat_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 2,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Train final XGBoost model on training data only
final_features <- importance_df$Feature
X_final_train <- X_train[, final_features, drop = FALSE]
X_final_test <- X_test[, final_features, drop = FALSE]
final_model <- xgboost(
  data = X_final_train,
  label = y_train,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 500,
  max_depth = 15,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)

# Make predictions on TEST data only
simple_predictions_trat <- predict(simple_model_trat, X_simple_trat_test)
simple_predictions_irat <- predict(simple_model_irat, X_simple_irat_test)
xgb_predictions <- predict(final_model, X_final_test)

# Create ROC curves using TEST data
roc_simple_trat <- roc(y_test, simple_predictions_trat)
roc_simple_irat <- roc(y_test, simple_predictions_irat)
roc_xgb <- roc(y_test, xgb_predictions)

# Plot ROC curves
plot(roc_simple_trat, col = "grey30", lwd = 2, 
     main = "ROC Comparison (Test Set)")
lines(roc_simple_irat, col = "lightblue", lwd = 2)
lines(roc_xgb, col = "#ff7b7b", lwd = 2)

# Add legend with AUC values
legend("bottomright", 
       legend = c(paste("pTau:tTau (AUC =", round(auc(roc_simple_trat), 3), ")"),
                  paste("CSF IgG/IgA Ratio (AUC =", round(auc(roc_simple_irat), 3), ")"),
                  paste("XGB (AUC =", round(auc(roc_xgb), 3), ")")),
       col = c("grey30", "lightblue", "#ff7b7b"), 
       lwd = 2)

# Print performance summary
cat("Training set size:", length(y_train), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", length(y_test), "\n")
cat("Test set positive rate:", round(mean(y_test), 3), "\n")
cat("Simple model pTau_tTau test AUC:", round(auc(roc_simple_trat), 3), "\n")
cat("Simple model CSF IgG/IgA x Age test AUC:", round(auc(roc_simple_irat), 3), "\n")
cat("XGBoost model test AUC:", round(auc(roc_xgb), 3), "\n")
cat("AUC improvement:", round(auc(roc_xgb) - auc(roc_simple), 3), "\n")
```
